profile.headline: Coder | Creator | Beatboxer
profile.summary: I'm a Cyber Software Engineer that works for Roguethink. Outside of work, I spent my time automating with Autohotkey, writing and ready Fantasy Novels, watching anime, playing PC games, developing PC games and more.

positions.title: Cyber Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Execute all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle to create and maintain software solutions via web development, script writing and systems engineering.
- Develop and maintain a customized Linux kernel with the C programming language, Visual Studio WPF GUI apps written in C# and XAML and various multi-purpose scripts written in Python and Bash on Windows, Linux and WSL environments.
- Utilize Docker with Kubernetes to create, deploy and manage containers providing numerous services across networks.
- Consider, plan and implement security requirements into all solutions.
- Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to achieve project milestones.
- Utilize the Agile Framework to manage work effectively using Gitlab and Azure DevOps.
- Have fun every day!

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop the GLUE (Global Lineup Engine) product to read in and provide data to other Navy Products, like TENA executions and SIMDIS, through subscriptions.
• Manage the full software engineering lifecycle for GLUE that includes behavior modeling, architecture design, user interface design and development, utility management and development environment maintenance to meet Navy Service Program Manager objectives.
• Perform software development that includes coding, testing, debugging and documenting using Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7, Git, Gradle, JavaScript, Ext JS, Java, Java Spring, Hibernate, PostgresSQL, VIM, Confluence and JIRA.
• Developed other enterprise systems JSAF (Joint Semi-Automated Forces), Tabletop & NEXUS.
• Collaborate directly with clients to ensure timely resolution of NCTE software engineering mission objectives.
• Provide clients with direct support from the office and at Navy sites to support test events, meet release deadlines and achieve other program objectives.

company.name: Mission Technologies, a division of HII

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Support the United States Army Training and Doctrine Command (TRADOC) Capability Manager – Army Training Information System (TCM-ATIS) via front-end code changes.
• Support the Army’s MT2, CAR and TAG websites by implementing bug fixes and product enhancements.
• Additional Role as Program Risk Manager. Duties include:
	o Coordinate with the Project Manager, Engineering Manager and Quality Manager to create and maintain the program’s Risk Management Plan, Risk Register and related deliverables.
	o Document and analyze incidents in real time by logging their description, duration, impact and other qualitative and quantitative metrics.
	o Create and present monthly risk project updates to the Chief of the Technical Integration Team and other project executives monthly.
	o Manage the Risk Team Coordinator by determining and delegating tasks for completion.

positions.title: Technical Support Analyst
positions.description:
* Redefines user experience with unparalleled technical skill and cutting-edge communication
* Strategically plans and designs customized security infrastructures
* Troubleshoots connectivity, hardware, and software issues daily
* Hosts small focus groups to tackle software updates, browser changes, and ISP outages
* Critiques front-end development and conceptualizes forward-thinking design ideas 
* Develops custom reports, allowing clients to develop all-encompassing solutions unique to their needs
* Assists with security breaches, monitoring fraudulent activity and addressing clients’ concerns

educations.schoolName: State University of New York at Fredonia

volunteerExperiences.role: Computer Lab Assistant & Basic Computer Use Tutor
volunteerExperiences.description:
* Developed lesson plans and taught introductory courses for all levels of experience 
* The sample material covered binary, logic gates, the OSI model, and basic algorithms
* Managed nine computer workstations by addressing all technical needs such as updating the operating systems to Windows 10, removing malware, fixing boot time issues, hardening security and more
* Used Microsoft Server 2013 Group Manager to manage enterprise class server permissions

organizations.name: Pinensula Reads
organizations.description: I taught individuals of all ages basic information about computer systems, how to type and using the software like web browsers, word applications and paint.
